Product updateThe new version is live

Click a class name above and watch which part of this card changes.

How classes become page styles

Map directly to CSS properties: Each utility class acts as a micro-instruction controlling a single property. For example, p-4 applies 1rem of padding, and text-lg sets a larger font size.

Responsive prefixes control breakpoints: By adding prefixes like md:, lg:, or sm:, you specify at which screen sizes the styles apply, doing responsive design directly in HTML.

State variants handle interactions: Using variants like hover:, focus:, or dark: allows elements to change appearance on interaction or theme change without writing complex selectors.

What people often confuse

When a class list is long, group it by spacing, text, borders, and layout. Repeated combinations usually belong in a component.

How classes become page styles

**Map directly to CSS properties:**Each utility class acts as a micro-instruction controlling a single property. For example, p-4 applies 1rem of padding, and text-lg sets a larger font size.

**Responsive prefixes control breakpoints:**By adding prefixes like md:, lg:, or sm:, you specify at which screen sizes the styles apply, doing responsive design directly in HTML.

**State variants handle interactions:**Using variants like hover:, focus:, or dark: allows elements to change appearance on interaction or theme change without writing complex selectors.
**What people often confuse**
When a class list is long, group it by spacing, text, borders, and layout. Repeated combinations usually belong in a component.
